text:
Priya: hey team — kicking off first-touch for Citrine Health. short thread to align staffing, success criteria, 30d readiness, and known renewal risks. cc @Ben @Aisha @Devon.

Ben: thanks. quick context: Citrine is planning to use Redwood Dedicated for conversational triage + embeddings for search. they want a POC in prod-like env within 30 days. key ask: predictable latency and audit logs for compliance.

Aisha: stakeholders from their side: Sara (PM), Mark (Eng lead), Leo (security/compliance), and Tanya (support manager). we'll need a technical kickoff + security review.

Devon: proposed short timeline:
- Day 0 (today): intro call + access checklist
- Day 1-5: infra provisioning + key pairing (Dedicated pool)
- Day 6-12: integration + sample traffic run (staging)
- Day 13-22: perf tuning, batching/quant config
- Day 23-30: final signoff and go-live support window

Carlos: high-level success criteria (customer-facing):
1) Endpoint availability >= 99.5% during go-live window
2) 95th pct generation latency < 300ms for 512 token flows
3) Audit logs retained and delivered to their S3/KMS integration
4) First-response NPS >= 8 in beta cohort (10-20 internal testers)

Priya: known renewal/health risks up front:
- Risk A: If latency spikes during real traffic we lose confidence quickly — mitigation: canary routing + pre-set fallback to smaller model (Devon).
- Risk B: Compliance delay if Leo flags key rotation or HSM gaps — mitigation: prioritize security review and assign SE to run KMS integration test (Aisha).
- Risk C: Costs look high for their budget — mitigation: run Optimize suggestions and autoscale limits; show cost projection (Carlos).

Ben: can we lock owners?
- technical lead (integration + perf): Devon
- security/KMS & audit logs: Aisha
- cost/runbook & billing questions: Carlos
- CSM / program lead: Priya

Priya: assigning in calendar now. action items: 
- Devon: share staging run checklist and sample load script by EOD.
- Aisha: schedule 30-45m security session with Leo for tomorrow.
- Carlos: estimate cost at 10k q/month with tuned batching and share a >90d projection.
- Ben: coordinate an exec 15m intro next week.

Devon: putting checklist here:
```
- ensure VPC peering established
- test token auth and rotation
- run sample 50 concurrent sessions @ 128 tokens
- collect traces (open-telemetry) + Redwood latency logs
```
I'll drop the k6 script link in thread.

Aisha: Leo requested a short doc on key rotation flow + HSM options. I'll mock one up and ping infra-security for review.

Carlos: I'll run Optimize on a representative prompt set once Devon shares baseline metrics. expect a first pass tomorrow.

Priya: timeline constraints: Citrine expects pilot report by day 21. let's aim to have clear pass/fail gating by day 18 to avoid surprises.

Ben: small ask — can we capture their feedback during the 2-week pilot via a short form? I can put together a 6-question pulse survey (NPS, latency perception, false positives, config friction, docs clarity, overall).

Priya: yes please. add survey link to the weekly checklist.

OnboardingBot: Reminder — provisioning ticket #RB-4821 created and assigned to infra-team. ETA 48h.

Devon: noted. I'm blocked waiting on their VPC CIDR and service account. Sara said they'll provide by EOD.

Aisha: ok, once Leo is in the session I'll confirm vault/KMS options.

Priya: perfect. next steps: owners do their tasks, update this thread with progress. final ask: if any gating risk appears, flag immediately with what falls into "go/no-go" by day 18. :thumbsup:

Ben: got it. will draft pulse survey and drop here.

Carlos: budget projection drafted — sharing in 2 hours.

Devon: k6 script link: https://internal.redwood/testing/citrine-k6-run — running now, will post results.

Priya: thanks everyone — i'll send calendar invites and a shared doc for day-by-day checklist.

Aisha: added security session invite for tomorrow 10am PT with Leo and Mark.

Ben: invite received.

Priya: closing the loop — owners: please update thread when items complete. if no blockers by EOD tomorrow we are green to proceed.

Devon: running perf test now, will report within 45m.

OnboardingBot: Ticket RB-4821 status: in-progress -> provisioned (updated by infra-bot).
